lifecycle.transition: Mode shell -> refs, preloads, maps, UI, and gameplay state available
instanceID+serializer absent -> allocate 0x00E82340, retain resource, link DAT_016B44F0; present -> reuse
mpResource null -> 0x00E822C0 -> 0x00E821D0 -> return cCellResource.mpData; cached -> increment use count
Existing cell/UI/GFX state -> pools/world refs reset, player recreated from startCell with derived scale/time state
Active mode -> presentation released, CellGame folder resources torn down, cached Cell payloads released, sCellGame+0x4121 cleared
No config -> property lookup; success copies int array, failure applies [5,5,5,5] and 1.0/1.0
